summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Omens
summary.text: Catalog entries 49–64 for Codex Florentinus 7, covering masculine and feminine signs, places, and stars; lots; planetary appellations; weather omens; lunar observations at the summer solstice; decan faces; terms; runaway persons; military expeditions; ambushes; tent pitching; delayed or imminent events; poisoning; travel; and eclipse outcomes. Authorities named include Rhetorius, Paulus Alexandrinus, Theophilus, Hermes, and Hephaestion.
